operation: Main validates with existing ballot merge/candidate APIs, then River installs through the existing data path. This worker performed no publication or production writes.

coverage.statement: Every local candidate contest and printed named candidate in the countywide composite ballot is included. Federal, statewide and legislative offices, all 17 already-held retention contests, and measures are outside this partial input. This is countywide composite coverage, not a single address sample. Later qualified/declared write-ins are not asserted complete.

declaredWriteIns.finding: These current official discovery pages link the composite and the August 28 candidate listing; neither displayed a separate declared-write-in link in this capture. Additional current declared-write-in acquisition remains with CX-LOCAL.

readerBoundaryDependency: Exact district/area memberships must be acquired before address/ZIP-specific reader coverage can be claimed; no district was mapped to its entire city, school district, or county.
nextOwner: Main: focused offline validation and commit; River: existing data install and live checks. CX-LOCAL geography work: acquire missing division boundaries/memberships and any later qualified write-ins.
